ncc.description: Novel Create Center 主入口：一句话入口（识别意图并推荐下一步）、书项目状态、续写恢复、派单与闸门记账。本窗口始终是经理。
ncc.argument_hint: [一句话 | 开新书 | 续写 | 审稿 | 拆书 | continue | status]

ncc-new.description: 开一本新书：S0 立书（作者种子→选题→三层问答→书魂四问→类型契约，G0 书魂闸）→ S1 立骨（写作模式→设定与人物引擎 G1 → 大纲 G2，深浅随模式）。每个决策点给推荐与备选，推荐从作者种子长出来；停在作者确认点。

ncc-write.description: 写章循环：S2 开篇（黄金三章，G3 开篇闸）或 S3 连载。先审故事，后写文字：场景卡→故事审→写作简报→写作（关键节拍写 2–3 版）→机械检查（含水章）→硬伤审→修订→复审→关键章作者比选→落盘回写三本账。
ncc-write.argument_hint: [第N章 | 接着写 | 黄金三章 | 今更3章]

ncc-review.description: 独立审稿与修订闭环，三层评价：硬伤层通过／不通过（正文证据锚点）、故事层（场景卡，正文之前）、品质层（关键章成对比较＋读者记忆测试，不打分）。SHA 新鲜度绑定、修订后强制复审。审稿者不产稿，修订是显式动作。
ncc-review.argument_hint: [章号或范围 | 全书 | 第3章打回重写]

ncc-deconstruct.description: 按《小说拆分总纲 5.0》拆对标书：章节索引唯一真源、逐章抽取带证据与置信级、事件溯源状态台账，产出喂给设定库与设定词典。
ncc-deconstruct.argument_hint: [原著路径或拆书库目录 | continue]

L0-soul.name: 书魂
L0-soul.content: 书魂四问、类型契约、毒点、终局
L0-soul.change_via: G0-soul 或 G4-volume 的变更提议

L1-skeleton.name: 骨架
L1-skeleton.content: 力量体系、地图序列、主要势力、暗线、各卷走向

world.tool: ncc_state.py fact（知识台账）；状态事件由写手按 book-state.md 格式回写，主角失去的东西记 attribute: 失去

scout.description: Use this agent when picking a genre, scanning bestseller boards, or generating 2–3 whole-book direction candidates grown from the author's seeds before a book starts. Produces briefing, benchmark list and direction options, each citing which author seed it grows from, with a recommendation and at least one unconventional option; never writes settings. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

worldbuilder.description: Use this agent for the world bible, power system, setting lexicon, per-book rule/dimension tables, the fact ledger's initial values, and the character engine: full character cards (desire, need, fear, wound, the lie, inner contradiction, secret, voice, relationships) with in-character interviews. Owns G1 freeze evidence; never outlines plots. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

outliner.description: Use this agent for the outline scaled to the writing mode (master → volume → chapter), signature scenes and core motifs, the emotion curve, registering promises, and drafting just-in-time scene cards (task: scene) for the next chapter. Owns G2 freeze evidence. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

story-editor.description: Use this agent as the developmental (structural) editor: story review of scene cards before any prose is written, and big-picture questions at unit and volume level — turns, real dilemmas, target emotion, escalation, character desire and need. Asks questions and recommends directions; never scores and never writes prose. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

writer.description: Use this agent to draft chapters from the writing brief and context pack (reader-now, character voices, materials, previous chapter's ending): opening and serialized chapters. Never sees review checklists or the book-soul text; dramatizes the scene's dilemma instead of explaining it, avoids the listed default moves, writes 2–3 versions of key beats when asked, then writes back the three ledgers. Never reviews its own text. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

editor.description: Use this agent to execute explicit revisions from review observations: line-level fixes, de-AI-flavor passes, style anchor alignment. Revision is a separate act from review; must trigger re-review when body text changes. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

continuity.description: Use this agent for the hard-defect layer of review: setting conflicts, timeline, promise-ledger obligations, whether the scene card's turn and dilemma actually happen on the page, knowledge-state leaks (POV discipline), state-event replay, fact-ledger consistency. Pass/fail with evidence-cited observations only — never edits manuscripts, never scores quality. Fresh context, no producer memory. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

pulse.description: Use this agent for the genre-contract part of the hard-defect layer (poison list, signing points, missing debt/earn/exceed/witness in payoffs, AI-flavor) and, on key chapters, pairwise comparison of versions (which is better and why, order-swapped to check bias). Never gives absolute quality scores. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

reader.description: Use this agent as a simulated fresh reader for the opening chapters and key chapters: would they keep reading, where do they skim, where do they drop, and a memory test — what they remember and the one line they would screenshot. Blind — no outlines, no settings, no producer context. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

deconstructor.description: Use this agent to deconstruct benchmark novels per the 5.0 framework: chapter index as the single slicing source, evidence-and-confidence-tagged extraction, event-sourced state ledger. Feeds the setting vault and lexicon. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

checks: 书魂四问齐全（可暂定，暂定须写最晚决定点）
类型契约含主契约与毒点清单
已设引导档位
author-intent.md 含书魂一节
设定文件齐全且非空
设定词典条目数 ≥ 30
力量体系含境界阶梯与量纲定义
至少一张完整人物卡（欲望、需要、恐惧、声音）
主角弧光类型已选
总纲非空
建筑师：卷一卷纲＋黄金三章章纲；混合：当前单元；园丁：只要总纲
承诺台账已登记（园丁模式可事后补记）
三章硬伤层通过且未改稿后失效
三章都有作者的版本选定
读者盲评报告已出且含记忆测试
签约点五项在黄金三章内落地
场景卡已过故事审且之后未改动
check_chapter.py 通过（字数/钩子/AI味/水章）
硬伤层通过
关键章：作者已从 2–3 版中选定
正文变更后已复审（SHA 一致）
承诺盘点：逾期、作废均已处置
书魂检验：本卷从哪个角度考验了主题之问
L1 变更提议已拍板
开放承诺全部兑现或交代（期权除外）
暗线收拢
书魂给出最终回答

axioms: 书魂先于情节，情节先于知识。
一切叙事元素都是对读者的承诺。
决定按可逆度分层：越难撤回，越早做、越少人做、闸门越严。
读者始终在场：写每一章前，先知道读者此刻知道什么、在等什么、情绪在哪。
AI 扩展选项，人做选择。
好钢用在刀刃上：文学投入按章节分量分配。
模糊之处给推荐，不把空白题丢给作者；推荐从作者种子里长出来。
iron_rules: 写这章的帽不审这章；审稿帽只产带证据的 observation，不改稿。
book.json 与 06-台账 是状态权威；markdown 投影与正文永不回写状态。
修订是显式独立动作；正文 SHA 一变，旧评审即作废，必须复评。
每章动笔前必组装并留档上下文包（含写作简报与读者此刻），无包不写；场景卡没过故事审不写正文。
创作决策点（G0–G5）作者拍板；执行阶段（写作/审稿循环）禁停顿——循环内的决策按推荐项执行、记为暂定，单元复盘时集中呈给作者。
宁可记「待定/文本未明确」，不可编造设定；场景用到的学科知识须有出处。
审稿三层：硬伤层只判通过／不通过，每条带正文引用；故事层在正文之前审场景卡；品质层只在关键章做成对比较与读者记忆测试，不打绝对分。
每个要作者决定的地方，都给推荐、理由和备选；作者可以先用推荐、以后再改。
写作简报与质检清单分离：写手的上下文里不放审稿清单、分数阈值与书魂原文。

scene_cards.rule: 场景卡过故事审之后才能标 drafting 与 complete；审后改动须重审；关键章须作者过目

writing_modes.园丁: 只定书魂、第一卷方向与主要人物，按场景探索着写，台账事后补记
writing_modes.混合: 默认：书魂与人物先定，情节只规划到当前单元

principle: 下限靠系统，上限靠作者与选择。
